claims.text: Research is a large business and almost all of it is sold by subscription and delivered as documents.
claims.quote: Research is a large business, and almost all of it is sold by subscription.

claims.text: Gartner, the largest firm in the field, reported $6.5 billion of revenue for 2025.
claims.quote: The largest firm in the field, Gartner, reported $6.5 billion of revenue for 2025

claims.text: Gartner's contracts run for a minimum of twelve months and 77% of them are multi-year.
claims.quote: for a minimum of twelve months, with 77% of its contracts multi-year

value.unit: percent of Gartner contracts that are multi-year

claims.text: Forrester reported $396.9 million of revenue for 2025.
claims.quote: Forrester reported $396.9 million for the same year.

claims.text: A chat over the documents, like Forrester's AI Access, is useful and still the same product underneath: one body of text, the same for every reader, reissued when out of date.
claims.quote: it is still the same product underneath: one body of text, the same for every reader, reissued when it is out of date.

claims.text: A taxonomy answers which vendors are in a category and is the right first step, but it is version one of what a graph can be.
claims.quote: A taxonomy answers "which vendors are in this category", and it is the right first step. But it is version one.

claims.text: A fractal semantic graph has the same shape at every level of zoom, with meaning carried by the edges, from the buyer's question down to the agent that produced each piece of evidence.
claims.quote: the same shape at every level of zoom, with meaning carried by the edges

claims.text: An sgit vault is a folder of encrypted files, versioned like git and opened with a key, and it can carry its own app.
claims.quote: An sgit vault is a folder of encrypted files, versioned like git and opened with a key, and it can carry its own app.

claims.text: Instead of a report, a research firm can deliver the research itself as a vault: findings with evidence, the graph, a briefing per reader, the calculations, a custom app and a lane back.
claims.quote: So instead of a report, a research firm can deliver the research itself

claims.text: With agents, ten versions of the same content for ten readers cost little more than one.
claims.quote: With agents, ten versions of the same content cost little more than one.

claims.text: An append lane is a folder the client can write to and never rewrite: comments, votes and flags.
claims.quote: An append lane is a folder the client can write to and never rewrite

claims.text: Because each vault has its own key, each client opens only the vaults it paid for, and a re-assessment is a new commit the client sees as a diff.
claims.quote: a re-assessment is a new commit, and the client sees what changed as a diff.

claims.text: Adding a model in front of an existing API looks like a feature but is a change in what the product can reach and who can steer it.
claims.quote: It is a change in what the product can reach and who can steer it.

claims.text: OWASP's Top 10 for LLM applications calls this Excessive Agency, rooted in excessive functionality, permissions and autonomy.
claims.quote: OWASP's Top 10 for LLM applications calls it Excessive Agency

claims.text: A crafted email made Microsoft 365 Copilot disclose data with no click, in June 2025.
claims.quote: a crafted email made Microsoft 365 Copilot disclose data with no click, in June 2025

claims.text: A web form field let attackers steal data through Salesforce's Agentforce, fixed in September 2025.
claims.quote: a web form field let attackers steal data through Salesforce's Agentforce, fixed in September.

claims.text: An Agent Behaviour Policy is a written description, for one agent in one deployment, of everything it can do, what it was authorised to do, the difference, and what stands in the way; it describes and does not judge.
claims.quote: a written description, for one agent in one deployment, of everything it can do, what it was authorised to do, the difference between the two, and what actually stands in the way

claims.text: For a product with an AI feature, write two behaviour policies, one without the AI and one with it; the difference is the research.
claims.quote: For a product with an AI feature, write two: one without the AI and one with it. The difference is the research.

claims.text: In the example, the product's reach goes from four systems to six once the AI agent is added.
claims.quote: the product's reach goes from four systems to six

value.unit: systems reached with the AI agent, from 4 without it

claims.text: Three of the product's eight rules rest only on the model following its instructions, two of them guarding money or data leaving the company.
claims.quote: three of its eight rules rest only on the model following its instructions, two of them guarding money or data leaving the company.

claims.text: The policy describes and the research firm judges, giving the grade buyers and insurers need: licence to operate, on what conditions, and how insurable the risk is.
claims.quote: The policy describes; the research firm judges.

claims.text: Lloyd's underwriters launched affirmative cover for AI failures in 2025, warning of silent AI cover.
claims.quote: Lloyd's underwriters launched affirmative cover for AI failures in 2025

claims.text: In November 2025 large insurers asked US regulators for permission to exclude AI liabilities from corporate policies.
claims.quote: in November 2025 large insurers asked US regulators for permission to exclude AI liabilities from corporate policies.

claims.text: ruv.sgit runs a Ruflo hive of Claude Code workers, with an sgit vault per run and a behaviour policy per role, and records every run in a ledger.
claims.quote: runs a Ruflo hive of Claude Code workers, an sgit vault per run and a behaviour policy for each role, and records every run in a ledger

claims.text: In the example evaluation, six workers ran 79 tasks and QA rejected two claims the evidence did not support.
claims.quote: In the example, six workers ran 79 tasks; QA rejected two claims the evidence did not support.

claims.text: Sell research by the block: a live evaluation, the vault for one product, a briefing per extra reader, a portfolio subscription refreshed as vendors ship, and a branded app.
claims.quote: Sell research by the block, priced for what a vault makes possible

claims.text: Everything built for this is open source, so a research firm can run it itself or have us run it.
claims.quote: so a research firm can run it itself, or have us run it.

claims.text: This site built a vault for a made-up research firm, Corvane Research, assessing a made-up product, Tallyfern Pay, before and after its AI agent.
claims.quote: this site built a vault for a made-up research firm, Corvane Research, assessing a made-up accounts payable product, Tallyfern Pay

claims.text: The example vault has thirteen pages, including two behaviour policies, an evaluation run, six findings, six briefings and a cost calculator.
claims.quote: It has thirteen pages: the product before and after AI, the two behaviour policies, the evaluation run and its ledger

claims.text: The example is synthetic: the firm, the product, the buyer, the findings and the prices are invented.
claims.quote: The example is synthetic. The firm, the product, the buyer, the findings and the prices are invented.

claims.text: The evaluation run in the example is illustrative; it follows ruv.sgit's ledger format and is not a real run.
claims.quote: The evaluation run in it is illustrative. It follows ruv.sgit's ledger format; it is not a real run.

claims.text: ruv.sgit is not automated end to end yet; its own page says a person starts and watches each run.
claims.quote: ruv.sgit is not automated end to end yet. Its own page says a person starts and watches each run.

claims.text: The grade is a judgement: the behaviour policy carries no score, and the firm's rating is its own over facts that are shown.
claims.quote: The grade is a judgement. The behaviour policy carries no score

claims.text: No research firm uses this today that the owner knows of; it is a proposal.
claims.quote: No research firm uses this today, that I know of. It is a proposal.

claims.text: The owner thinks there is a much better product hiding in the same research work.
claims.quote: I think there is a much better product hiding in the same work.
